stem: A published cannabis life-cycle study reports a developmental feature at a particular node in one cultivar under defined conditions. A different cultivar does not show that feature at the same node. What is the best academic interpretation?
choices: The study documents a possible developmental pattern, but its exact node timing should not be treated as a universal rule
The different cultivar is necessarily abnormal
The published study must be incorrect
Node position has no value in cannabis observation
rationale: Cannabis-specific studies can support morphology and developmental reasoning while remaining bounded by genotype and study conditions. Generalization beyond the evidence should be explicit and cautious.
